name: arena
tagline: A continuous red-team versus blue-team simulation against a live vulnerable server, with verified patches.

awards: Neelbauer Agentic Revolution Award (NARA) - Alumni Prize

problem: Security testing needs adversaries that adapt without retraining.
solution: A local LLM red team chooses attacks, a rule-based blue team mitigates, and Gemini writes reports and patches that are verified each episode.
demo_moment: Team-described: watch an attack, mitigation and patch cycle.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Neelbauer Agentic Revolution Award (NARA) - Alumni Prize” among 223 submissions.

lessons: Close the loop: attack, fix, verify.
